name: Currency Input
description: A numeric amount field with a leading currency symbol that formats the value with Intl.NumberFormat on blur.
usage:
<CurrencyInput
  label="Invoice total"
  currency="USD"
  locale="en-US"
  defaultValue={1234.5}
  onChange={(amount) => console.log(amount)}
/>

anatomy.description: The visible label associated with the amount field.
A fixed-width leading addon derived from the currency code; decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
A decimal text field that emits the parsed number and reformats with Intl.NumberFormat on blur.
Optional description, for example the min and max limits, linked with aria-describedby.

dos: Set the currency and locale from the user's account, not the server's location.
Clamp with min and max when a budget or limit exists, and say so in the description.
Store the emitted number, not the formatted display string.
donts: Don't use it for values without a currency; use NumberInput.
Don't use one field for multi-currency entry; pair a currency Select with the amount.

examples.title: Currency and locale
examples.description: The symbol and fraction digits follow the currency code, while grouping and separators follow the locale.

examples.title: Clamped budget
examples.description: min and max clamp the committed amount on blur, and a description explains the limits.

guidance.useWhen: The user enters a monetary amount in a known currency, such as prices, budgets, or invoice totals.
guidance.avoidWhen: The value is a plain number without a currency; use NumberInput instead. For multi-currency entry, pair a Select with NumberInput.
guidance.behavior: Emits the parsed number on every edit (undefined when emptied) and formats the display with Intl.NumberFormat on blur, clamping to min/max.
guidance.responsive: The field stretches to fill its container; the leading symbol addon stays a fixed width.

notes: The visible label is associated with the input; use aria-label when there is no visible label.
The currency symbol is decorative (aria-hidden) because the formatted value communicates the unit.
inputMode="decimal" summons a numeric keypad on touch devices.
